title: micromatch stack: add a maxItems limit to brace expansion
prompt: packages/ holds a slice of the micromatch dependency tree (micromatch, picomatch, braces, fill-range, to-regex-range, is-number), resolved by plain Node with NODE_PATH=packages. Add an option `maxItems` to brace expansion: when `braces.expand(...)` or `braces(input, { expand: true })` would produce more than `maxItems` items for one pattern, throw a `RangeError` whose message contains `maxItems` instead of returning them (for an array of patterns the limit applies to each pattern separately). It must also apply through `micromatch.braceExpand` and `micromatch.braces(pattern, { expand: true, ... })`. `null` or `undefined` means unlimited (the default), compile mode (`expand` not set) is not affected, and a brace set that is not a real expansion (like `a{b}c`) is returned as before.
